subject: Looking for technique to prevent file collision / corruption.

messages.author: 9507d090705a9cd3
messages.subject: Looking for technique to prevent file collision / corruption.
parts:
Hello,

I am developing a shiny app that will be hosted on a shiny server.  The app reads and writes multiple files.  What technique can I use to prevent file collision / corruption when multiple users use the app at the same time?  I was thinking of adding "sessionID" to part of a filename, but sessionID is not available with shiny server.

Many thanks for any help.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Looking for technique to prevent file collision / corruption.
parts:
Are these just temporary files or do they need to persist? If temporary, you could create a temp directory for each session under tempdir() with some random numbers added, e.g.:

file.path(tempdir(), paste0("mydata", as.integer(runif(1, min=1000000, max=9999999))))

But don't forget to delete each session's directory when the session ends (session$onSessionEnded(function() { unlink(...) }) ).

Alternatively, perhaps a proper database would make sense?

messages.subject: Re: Looking for technique to prevent file collision / corruption.
parts:
If you're just trying to keep the selectize input populated with choices from the file upload, then just do something like this:

observe({
    iFile <- input$data1
    tFile <- read.table(iFile$datapath, header=TRUE, sep=input$sep, quote = "")
    updateSelectizeInput( session, "ID", server = TRUE, choices = unique(rownames(tFile)))
})

On Fri, Aug 28, 2015 at 3:03 PM, Austin D Nguyen <nguy...@onid.oregonstate.edu> wrote:

My server.R is below. When I try to make this (the mapurl) reactive to user input i see Error in as.vector(x, "character") : cannot coerce type 'closure' to vector of type 'character...error..

Do you see anything that is incorrect?


shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

mapurl <- reactive(mapurl <- session$registerDataObj(

name = 'Names',
iFile <- input$data1,
tFile <- read.table(iFile$datapath, header=TRUE, sep=input$sep, quote = ""),
filter = function(tFile, req){

  query -> parseQueryString(req$QUERY_STRING)
  ID = query$ID
  finally = dev.off()
}))

output$contents <- renderTable({

inFile <- input$data1

if (is.null(inFile))
  return(NULL)

read.table(inFile$datapath, header=TRUE, sep=input$sep, quote = "")

})

output$Plot <- renderPlot({ iFile <- input$data1

tFile <- read.table(iFile$datapath, header=TRUE, sep=input$sep, quote = "")
plot(c(1, 13), range(as.matrix(tFile)), type = 'n', xaxt = 'n', las = 1,
     xlab = 'Experimental Points', ylab = 'Flux and Impact')
matlines(t(tFile), type = 'l', lty = 1, col = 'gray')
axis(1, 1:13, colnames(tFile))

})

updateSelectizeInput( session, "ID", server = TRUE, choices = setdiff(rownames(tFile)), options = list(render = I(sprintf( "{ option: function(item, escape) { return '' + escape(item.value) + ''; } }", mapurl ))) ) })
